name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B

lineage.how_derived: successor release on the same architecture (the card compares directly)

purpose: The card highlights stronger agentic coding, frontend and repository-level reasoning, and an option to preserve reasoning from earlier messages. It states no separate target-user sentence.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE file in the repo read: Apache License 2.0 with the vendor copyright appendix ('Copyright 2026 Alibaba Cloud'), no additional terms. (11,343 bytes; same md5 as the Qwen-AgentWorld LICENSE).

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated DeltaNet + gated attention MoE, vision encoder
architecture.attention: 10 x (3 Gated DeltaNet + 1 gated attention), hidden 2048
architecture.why_this_design: Card: 'Efficient Hybrid Architecture: Gated Delta Networks combined with sparse Mixture-of-Experts deliver high-throughput inference with minimal latency and cost overhead.' (Qwen3.6 card shares the Qwen3.5 layout)

pc-16gb.variant: Q4_K_M 22 GB, experts partly in RAM

mac-16-24gb.notes: The 22 GB file does not fit 16 GB.

strengths: Agentic coding and tool use improved over Qwen3.5 (SWE-bench Verified 70.0 to 73.4, Terminal-Bench 2.0 40.5 to 51.5; vendor)
NVIDIA's Lightning card uses it as the strongest listed yardstick on most rows
weaknesses: Knowledge numbers flat or lower than Qwen3.5 (MMLU-Pro 85.3 to 85.2, HLE 22.4 to 21.4, TAU3 68.9 to 67.2)
best_for: General assistant that also codes, in one model

user_reports.summary: Community benchmark of the NVFP4 build on two RTX 5060 Ti with vLLM: 210 tok/s aggregate, GPQA Diamond 81.3 with thinking, SimpleQA Verified only 19.4 (low factual recall), thinking-off overall drops from 60.9 to 40.5 percent. Single author, one reader objected to the quality of the linked page.

tona_fit.reason: Same machinery and license as the 3.5 sibling with an agentic-coding gain; independent German is a step up on MMLU-ProX (80.0 vs 73.4 for the 9B) but INCLUDE DE is only 68.3 and the SimpleQA Verified score is low (19.4), so pick between 3.5 and 3.6 by a knowledge test. Apache-2.0 (text read).
